title: And, but, so, because, although
summary: Nối ý trong câu: and (thêm), but và although (đối lập), because (lý do), so (kết quả).

dialogue.en: How was your trip to Sa Pa?
dialogue.vi: Chuyến đi Sa Pa thế nào?

dialogue.en: It was beautiful, [[but]] it was really cold.
dialogue.vi: Đẹp lắm, nhưng lạnh kinh khủng.
Không, vì trời mưa cả ngày.

dialogue.en: That's a pity. [[Although]] it rained, did you have fun?
dialogue.vi: Tiếc nhỉ. Dù mưa, bạn có vui không?

dialogue.en: Yes! I bought a warm jacket, [[so]] I was OK. [[And]] the food was great!
dialogue.vi: Có! Mình mua một cái áo ấm nên không sao. Mà đồ ăn ngon lắm!

sections.heading: And: thêm ý. But: ý ngược lại
sections.rule: **and** = và (thêm ý cùng chiều). **but** = nhưng (ý ngược lại). Trước **but** thường có **dấu phẩy**.

examples.en: I like coffee [[and]] my wife likes tea.
examples.vi: Tôi thích cà phê, còn vợ tôi thích trà.
examples.why: And nối hai ý cùng chiều.

examples.en: The hotel was cheap, [[but]] it was very clean.
examples.vi: Khách sạn rẻ nhưng rất sạch.
examples.why: But: ý ngược lại với mong đợi (rẻ thường không sạch).

examples.en: I called him, [[but]] he didn't answer.
examples.vi: Tôi gọi cho anh ấy nhưng anh ấy không nghe máy.
examples.why: Kết quả trái mong đợi → but.

check.prompt: The food was good, ___ the service was slow.

sections.heading: Because: lý do. So: kết quả
sections.rule: **because** + **lý do** (vì). **so** + **kết quả** (nên). Không dùng cả hai trong một câu.
body: Tiếng Việt hay nói *Vì… nên…*. Tiếng Anh chỉ chọn **một**: *Because it rained, we stayed home* hoặc *It rained, so we stayed home*. Không nói *Because it rained, so we stayed home*.

examples.vi: Tôi mệt vì làm việc khuya.

examples.en: It was raining, [[so]] we took a taxi.
examples.vi: Trời mưa nên chúng tôi đi taxi.

examples.en: [[Because]] the shop was closed, we went home.
examples.vi: Vì cửa hàng đóng cửa nên chúng tôi về nhà.
examples.why: Because đứng đầu câu → không thêm so.

check.prompt: I was hungry, ___ I made some noodles.
check.explain: Nấu mì là kết quả → so.

sections.heading: Although: mặc dù
sections.rule: **although** = mặc dù. Không dùng **but** trong cùng câu với although.
body: Tiếng Việt nói *Mặc dù… nhưng…*. Tiếng Anh chỉ chọn **một**: *Although it was late, we stayed* hoặc *It was late, but we stayed*.

examples.en: [[Although]] it was expensive, I bought it.
examples.vi: Mặc dù đắt, tôi vẫn mua.
examples.why: Although đầu câu → không thêm but.

examples.en: She went to work [[although]] she was sick.
examples.vi: Cô ấy vẫn đi làm dù đang ốm.
examples.why: Although giữa câu → không cần dấu phẩy.

check.prompt: ___ he studied hard, he failed the test.
check.explain: Học chăm mà vẫn trượt → ý ngược lại → Although.

mistakes.wrong: Because it rained, so we stayed home.
mistakes.right: Because it rained, we stayed home.
mistakes.why: Chỉ dùng because hoặc so, không dùng cả hai.

mistakes.wrong: Although it was cold, but we went swimming.
mistakes.right: Although it was cold, we went swimming.

mistakes.wrong: I was tired, because I went to bed early.
mistakes.right: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
mistakes.why: Đi ngủ sớm là kết quả → so.

mistakes.wrong: She is kind but she is beautiful.
mistakes.right: She is kind and she is beautiful.

mistakes.wrong: I stayed home so I was sick.
mistakes.right: I stayed home because I was sick.
mistakes.why: Bị ốm là lý do → because.

exercises.prompt: I couldn't sleep ___ the room was too hot.
exercises.explain: Phòng nóng là lý do → because.

exercises.prompt: It was late, ___ we took a Grab home.
exercises.explain: Đi Grab là kết quả → so.

exercises.prompt: ___ the weather was bad, we enjoyed the trip.
exercises.explain: Thời tiết xấu mà vẫn vui → although.

options: Because I was late, I took a taxi.
Because I was late, so I took a taxi.
exercises.explain: Không dùng cả because và so.

exercises.prompt: I like Hanoi, ___ I don't like the traffic.
We stayed inside ___ it was raining.
The phone was cheap, ___ I bought two.
___ he's only ten, he plays the piano very well.

exercises.vi: Tôi đói nên tôi ăn một cái bánh mì.
Cô ấy ở nhà vì cô ấy bị ốm.

exercises.sentence: Because I was busy, so I didn't call you.
answers: Because I was busy, I didn't call you.

exercises.sentence: Although it was cheap, but it was good.
answers: Although it was cheap, it was good.

exercises.sentence: He was sick, because he stayed in bed.
answers: He was sick, so he stayed in bed.
exercises.explain: Nằm nghỉ là kết quả → so.

exercises.vi: Trời mưa nên chúng tôi ở nhà.
answers: It rained, so we stayed home.
It rained, so we stayed at home.
It was raining, so we stayed home.
It was raining, so we stayed at home.
It's raining, so we're staying home.
It's raining, so we're staying at home.

exercises.vi: Mặc dù mệt, tôi vẫn đi làm.
answers: Although I was tired, I went to work.
Although I was tired, I still went to work.
I went to work although I was tired.
Although I'm tired, I still go to work.
Although I am tired, I still go to work.
